Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 3933 of 2024

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.

Applicant being accused has approached this Court through this application under Section 482 Code of Criminal Procedure seeking quashing of the order dated 08.01.2024 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, court no.11, Azamgarh, titled Bindu Bhardwaj vs. Jagat Narayan Yadav, in Case No.4473 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 93 of 2021, under Sections 328, 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Maharajganj, District Azamgarh, whereby non bailable warrants have been issued against him to secure his presence.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Bindu Bhardwaj vs. Jagat Narayan Yadav
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that after completion of investigation in the case, a cancellation report was submitted under Section 173(2) Code of Criminal Procedure.
However, on the basis of the protest petition filed by the complainant, further investigation was ordered on 7th May, 2022.

He submits that after completion of the further investigation, the applicant has been charge- sheeted through supplementary report dated 19.05.2023, whereupon, the cognizance order was passed on 14.11.2023.

Learned counsel has argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated by the Jagat Narayan Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157998574/
1 opposite party no.2 and after committal of the case, the trial court issued non- bailable warrants against him on 8th January, 2024, without issuing any bailable warrants.

entities.text: Jagat Narayan Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He has pointed out that even the application seeking recall of the order dated 8th of January, 2024 has also been dismissed on 17.01.2024.

Learned counsel prays that in this background, it would be in the interest of justice,
if, the entire prosecution case is quashed, as no case is made out against the applicant in view of the two conflicting reports submitted by Investigating Officer.

After hearing the learned counsel and considering his submissions this Court does not find any merit in the case, as concededly the concession of bail was granted to the applicant vide order dated 1st May, 2023, wherein specific condition was imposed that the applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal appearance has been exempted.

Apparently, the applicant has violated the said condition of the bail, who is not appearing before the court despite issuance of the warrants, therefore, considering his conduct, this Court is not inclined to entertain this petition for quashing of the first information report.
Besides, the grounds and issues raised in this application can also be pressed by him before the trial court at the stage of consideration of impugned charge- sheet.
Resultantly, without meaning any expression of opinion on the merits of this case, this application is dismissed.
